title: StartupCincy Week marks a decade of building Cincinnati’s startup community
author: Erin Pierce
summary: Preview of the 10th StartupCincy Week (Oct. 5–8), expected to draw about 1,500 people, with Cintrifuse's Abby Grimm on its grassroots #StartupCincy origins, the four daily themes, the new city-building track, the Startup Clubhouse, VentureHaus and the first full Student Day.

title: Highlights from StartupCincy Week 2025
author: Stephen Kenney
summary: Recap of StartupCincy Week 2025 (Oct. 6–9) from UC's perspective: 1819 Innovation Hub startups and UC experts who presented, the $200,000 pitch competition, and the City of Cincinnati's "City as a Lab" program.

title: New $200K pitch competition to anchor StartupCincy Week
author: Casey Weldon
summary: Announced a $200,000 live pitch competition for StartupCincy Week 2025, organized by Cintrifuse and powered by Connetic Ventures, with five finalists pitching Oct. 7 at Union Hall.

title: StartupCincy Week to highlight region as hub of innovation, opportunity
author: Movers and Makers
summary: Preview of StartupCincy Week 2024 (Oct. 7–10), centered at Union Hall, with daily themes and featured speakers.

title: StartupCincy Week 2024 Registration Open for Eighth Annual Event
summary: Announcement of the eighth annual StartupCincy Week (Oct. 7–10, 2024) with the daily themes, program features, speaker list and ticket prices.

title: Homegrown Hustle
author: Emma O'Dell
summary: StartupCincy's recap of StartupCincy Week 2023 (Oct. 23–26): over 1,000 attendees, 45 events and over 100 speakers, and the planning-committee partners.

title: StartupCincy Week to highlight Cincy as hub of innovation, opportunity
author: Casey Weldon
summary: Preview of StartupCincy Week 2023 (Oct. 23–26) at Union Hall, themed "Homegrown Hustle", including the first formal partnership with the Over-The-Rhine Chamber of Commerce.

title: Spark the Future
author: Kate Hursh-Wogenstahl
summary: StartupCincy's recap of the sixth annual StartupCincy Week (Oct. 10–14, 2022): over 1,000 people, 35 events and over 150 speakers across four venues.

title: Techstars Startup Week in October 2017 provided promise for 2018 -- for itself and its attendees
author: Kevin Eigelbach
summary: Recap of the first Techstars Startup Week Cincinnati (Oct. 9–13, 2017, Union Hall), which beat its goals for sponsorship, attendance, events and diversity.
